changes: Added ignored root authority_trust.env support for Authority config resolution. The CLI now parses safe shell-style trust env values, maps LIVE_URL/LIVE_PUBLIC_KEY/CUSTOMER_API_KEY_FILE aliases, uses the trust file for Authority readiness in enabled modes, reports authorityTrustEnvLoaded/urlSource in authority_status, and lets policy discovery use the resolved trust URL. Also fixed authority_status and conduit_status so mode=off performs zero trust-file/secret-file I/O.
usage: Place authority_trust.env at the Lattice CLI project root. Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js authority_status --authorityMode=enforce --json to inspect non-sensitive readiness fields. For policy discovery, run lattice authority_enforce_policy with Authority mode enabled; it will resolve URL defaults through the same config path. Keep Authority Server completion separate from local readiness.
expectedOutcome: Expected: root authority_trust.env is ignored, enforce-mode status reports authorityTrustEnvLoaded=true with URL/customer/server readiness from the trust file, explicit env/CLI overrides still win, and off-mode status surfaces do not read trust or secret files.
actualTranscript: Observed non-sensitive projection: authorityTrustEnvLoaded=true, urlSource=authority_trust_env, baseURLConfigured=true, customerApiKeyConfigured=true, customerApiKeySource=authority_trust_env, serverPublicKeyPinned=true, actorKeyConfigured=false, runnerConfigured=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, canClaimProductionDone=false. Off-mode probe showed reads=[] for both authority_status and conduit_status. git status showed !! authority_trust.env.
outcomeDiff: Actual matches expected. The only remaining readiness warnings are actor/runner inputs not present in the provided trust file; they are not required for this story and are not treated as Authority completion.
limitations: No Authority Server receipt was verified or claimed. This is local Non-authority readiness/configuration support only; production Authority completion still requires receipt-backed proof.
pitfalls: Two review rounds found real off-mode I/O boundary leaks: first in authority_status, then in conduit_status. Both now use mode-aware customer-key resolution, with smoke coverage for zero reads in off mode.
